guidance.note: Tesla's Q3 2026 Update contains a qualitative Outlook section only — no next-quarter or full-year revenue, EPS, margin, capex or FCF guidance ranges. Per platform rules this is recorded as NOT PROVIDED; nothing is manufactured or derived into a guidance figure.
qualitative_outlook_as_disclosed: Volume: focused on maximum factory capacity utilisation; deliveries/deployments will be impacted by aggregate demand, supply-chain readiness and allocation between customer sales and the owned/operated fleet (deck, Outlook).
Cash: will manage the business to maintain a strong balance sheet and sufficient liquidity to fund the product roadmap and long-term capacity expansion, incl. vertical integration (deck, Outlook).
Profit: over time, hardware-related profits are expected to be accompanied by an acceleration of SI, software and fleet-based profits (deck, Outlook — qualitative, unquantified).
Production has begun for Tesla Semi in Nevada and Optimus in Fremont; capacity build-out for SI compute, solar, battery materials and semiconductor manufacturing is underway (deck, Outlook).

Call Q&A is NOT ANALYZED and must not be inferred.

earnings_quality.rationale: Revenue was flat YoY (-0.2%) and operating income fell 56% with operating margin down 322 bp to 2.6%; GAAP EPS fell 44%. Positives: gross profit rose 8.7% and total gross margin expanded 160 bp YoY, services revenue grew 33%, and the non-GAAP decline was modest (-4%). Negatives on quality: regulatory-credit revenue collapsed to $113M from $417M, operating expenses rose 39% YoY (R&D +69%), and the GAAP-to-non-GAAP gap is mostly recurring SBC ($982M net of tax), not a one-off.

forward_outlook.rationale: No formal numeric guidance was provided (NOT PROVIDED) — there is no raised/lowered guide to score. Qualitative signals are mixed-positive: largest vehicle backlog in four years, Robotaxi/Semi/Optimus ramps, and an SI/software profit-acceleration narrative that is explicitly long-dated ('over time'). Against that, battery availability was cited as the limiting factor on auto volumes in the quarter.

cash_quality.verdict: Strong in the quarter (deteriorating TTM trend)
cash_quality.rationale: Q3 OCF $6.26B and FCF +$1.53B (vs pre-report outflow expectations in the labelled snapshot), FCF conversion ~195% of GAAP attributable net income, and cash + short-term investments rose $1.9B to $45.45B. The trend flag: TTM FCF fell to $3.30B from $6.83B a year ago because TTM capex nearly doubled to $15.41B — cash quality is strong now, but the investment ramp is absorbing a rising share of it.
